description: This file provides authentication-related services, including login, registration, password reset, email verification, OAuth URL retrieval, profile fetching, and logout functionalities. It primarily serves as a client-side API wrapper for authentication endpoints.

methods.name: login(email, password)
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password, returning a simulated token and user info, or an error message.

methods.name: register(payload)
methods.description: Registers a new user with provided payload, returning a message or an error.

methods.name: requestPasswordReset(email)
methods.description: Triggers a password reset email, returns a message indicating if an account exists.

methods.name: resetPassword(token, password)
methods.description: Resets a password using a token, returning a success message.

methods.name: verifyEmail(token)
methods.description: Verifies email with a token, returning confirmation message.

methods.name: getOAuthUrl(provider)
methods.description: Constructs and returns the OAuth URL for a specified provider.

methods.name: getProfile(token)
methods.description: Retrieves current user profile information if a token is provided, otherwise throws an error.

methods.name: logout()
methods.description: Performs logout operation, possibly notifying backend, returns true.

ctags.name: email
ctags.pattern: /^    const res = { token: 'dev-token', user: { email, role: 'user' } };$/

ctags.pattern: /^    const res = { message: 'Registered. Please verify your email.' };$/
